newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: AMIC sets rights issue at 145 rand/share.
newsitem.headline: AMIC sets rights issue at 145 rand/share.

text.p: South Africa's Anglo American Industrial Corp (AMIC) said on Monday that it is to go ahead with a planned rights offer of 8.196 million new ordinary shares at 145 rand a share.
The offer will be on the basis of 12 new ordinary shares for every 100 AMIC shares held at the close of trade on October 4.
On September 19 said it planned a 1.2 billion rand rights issue to help fund new projects.

Amic said that the funds would be used both to assist in financing several major new projects and developments, and to supplement existing permanent resources to let the company take advantage of new opportunities as they arise.
The group and its companies are currently committed to capital expenditure -- both replacement and expansionary -- in excess of four billion rand.
- the recently announced acqusition by Mondi of the mining and timber interests of H.L.H. Timber Holdings valued at one billion rand;
- participation in AECI's global placement, announce on Wednesday;
- and Amic's acquisition last year of 20 percent of Hulett Aluminium, which is engaged in a 2.4 billion rand expansion of its rolled products facility.
